correctness.rationale: The precise three complex smooth curves C_d: Z^d+F_d(X,Y)=0 have |Aut|=60d and source-published groups G30=C15 x SL(2,5), G20=C5 x (SL(2,5) ⋊ C2), G12=C3 x (SL(2,5) ⋊ C2). Normal SL(2,5) is perfect, so their commutator equals D=SL(2,5); quotient G/D is cyclic of degree d/2, and N_d∩D is its central two-element subgroup. The three full branch values of the binary-icosahedral A5 reduced map have a full 60 inertia at the F_d zero-orbit and other full inertia (2,3),(2,5),(3,5), fixed by RH and A5 stabilizer orders. Mapping to the residual cyclic quotient yields signatures (6,2,3),(10,2,5),(15,3,5) (up to ordering), and RH gives genera 1,2,4 respectively. Recomputed the two RH identities exactly in rational arithmetic for all three cases. Source group structures and three-branch geometry are substantive published inputs, not independently re-proved.
